verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Notion's own developer quickstart, a guided first-time walkthrough. It has an engineer create a personal access token, make a first API request and see a new page appear in the workspace in under two minutes [notion-docs-11]. This is engineer onboarding, but it covers first API use rather than workspace setup, so credit is minimal. Missing for 10: a documented guided walkthrough for configuring a new workspace (structure, teamspaces, templates, members), in-app onboarding flow evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the first-run experience.
